title: Far and Away
description: A young free-spirited Irish woman from an affluent Protestant family spontaneously befriends a street-smart commoner cheated by her family’s hostile land takeovers. They escape to America, ready to take advantage of the 19th century Oklahoma land rush.

title: Two Bits
description: It's a hot summer day in 1933 in South Philly, where 12-year old Gennaro lives with his widowed mom and his ailing grandpa, who sits outside holding tight to his last quarter, which he's promised to Gennaro and which Gennaro would like to have to buy a ticket to the plush new movie theater. But grandpa's not ready to pass on the quarter or pass on to his final reward: he has some unfinished business with a woman from his past, and he enlists Gennaro to act as his emissary.

title: Lifeguard
description: Rick is a Los Angeles County lifeguard who is in his thirties. At his 15-year high school reunion, he sees his old girlfriend who is now a divorced mother. After falling in love with her, Rick considers changing his career and lifestyle.

title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
description: Based on Jack Finney's serialized novel, which was published as a book in 1955, Invasion of the Body Snatchers is a classic sci-fi film noir directed by Don Siegel. It follows a small-town doctor in Santa Mira, California, who discovers that alien plant spores are replacing his neighbors with emotionless, identical duplicates while they sleep.

title: Star Wars I: The Phantom Menace
description: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) is a young apprentice Jedi knight under the tutelage of Qui-Gon Jinn (Liam Neeson) ; Anakin Skywalker (Jake Lloyd), who will later father Luke Skywalker and become known as Darth Vader, is just a 9-year-old boy. When the Trade Federation cuts off all routes to the planet Naboo, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan are assigned to settle the matter.

title: Starship Troopers
description: In the distant future, the Earth is at war with a race of giant alien insects. Little is known about the Bugs except that they are intent on the eradication of all human life. But there was a time before the war... A Mobile Infantry travels to distant alien planets to take the war to the Bugs. They are a ruthless enemy with only one mission: Survival of their species no matter what the cost...

title: 12 Monkeys
description: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

title: I, Robot
description: In 2035, highly intelligent robots fill public service positions throughout the world, operating under three rules to keep humans safe. Despite his dark history with robotics, Detective Del Spooner (Will Smith) investigates the alleged suicide of U.S. Robotics founder Alfred Lanning (James Cromwell) and believes that a human-like robot (Alan Tudyk) murdered him. With the help of a robot expert (Bridget Moynahan), Spooner discovers a conspiracy that may enslave the human race.

title: Lost in Space
description: Fast and furious space adventure in which a dying Earth depends on one all-American family for its salvation. On their way to colonise a new world, the family run into some unexpected problems. Soon, they find themselves lost in space with little more than a psychotic villain and a variety of unwholesome aliens for company.

title: Farscape
description: American astronaut John Crichton finds himself thrown across the universe when an experimental mission goes bad. Crichton teams up with a group of rebels involved in an intergalactic battle and begins a journey unlike anything he dreamed was possible while trying to find a way back to Earth.

title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
description: Now 25, Connor (Nick Stahl) lives with no record of his existence -- no way he can be traced by Skynet. Out of the shadows of the future steps the T-X (Kristanna Loken), Skynet's most sophisticated cyborg killing machine yet. Now Connor's only hope for survival is the Terminator (Arnold Schwarzenegger), his mysterious former assassin. Together, they must triumph over the technologically superior T-X and forestall the looming threat of Judgment Day.

title: 101 Dalmations
description: 101 Dalmatians (1996) is a live-action remake of Disney’s animated classic, following a daring rescue mission when a fur-obsessed fashion designer kidnaps Dalmatian puppies for a lavish coat. Packed with slapstick, charming performances, and adorable canines, it’s highlighted by Glenn Close’s memorable turn as Cruella de Vil. While reviews were mixed, it remains lighthearted family fun and a nostalgic watch for fans of the original.

title: Muppets Treasure Island
description: Muppet Treasure Island (1996) is a musical comedy adventure where Jim Hawkins embarks on a swashbuckling treasure hunt with Kermit’s Captain Smollett, facing pirates led by the charming yet scheming Long John Silver. Blending Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic tale with the Muppets’ trademark humor, catchy songs, and colorful characters, it’s a lighthearted, family-friendly romp. Critics praise Tim Curry’s performance and the film’s fun, making it a nostalgic treat worth watching.

title: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
description: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid (1992) follows eccentric inventor Wayne Szalinski, whose latest experiment accidentally causes his toddler son to grow to monumental proportions whenever exposed to electricity. As the oversized child heads for Las Vegas, the family scrambles to reverse the process before chaos ensues. While lighter and more juvenile than its predecessor, it offers fun visual effects and harmless family comedy, making it an enjoyable, if modest, sequel.

title: E.T. The Extra Terrestrial
description: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial follows a lonely boy, Elliott, who forms a deep bond with a gentle alien stranded on Earth and tries to help him return home while evading government capture. Blending heartfelt drama, childhood wonder, and imaginative sci-fi, Steven Spielberg’s film is praised for its emotional depth, iconic imagery, and John Williams’ unforgettable score, making it a timeless family classic worth watching for all ages.

title: The Elm-Chanted Forest
description: A painter who can temporarily talk to the creatures of an enchanted forest must help them stop the evil Cactus King, who's building an army of magical living weapons and machines to turn the forest into a wasteland perfect for the cacti.

title: Mulan
description: Mulan follows a courageous young woman who disguises herself as a man to take her father’s place in the Chinese army, embarking on a journey of honor, self-discovery, and heroism. Combining stunning animation, heartfelt themes, humor, and memorable songs, the film delivers both adventure and emotional depth. Critics praise it as an empowering Disney classic that appeals to all ages, making it a must-watch.

title: Muppets from Space
description: Muppets from Space follows Gonzo as he searches for his origins and becomes convinced he’s connected to aliens. When he’s kidnapped by a secret government agency, Kermit and the gang set out on a zany rescue mission. Packed with quirky humor, celebrity cameos, and a funky soundtrack, it offers lighthearted fun for Muppet fans, though some critics note a thinner plot and less energy than earlier films.

title: Free Willy
description: Free Willy (1993) tells the heartfelt story of a troubled 12-year-old boy who bonds with a captive orca at a struggling amusement park and risks everything to help his new friend. Blending themes of friendship, second chances, and compassion for animals, it combines touching performances, a stirring score, and a classic feel-good formula. Praised for its warmth and uplifting message, it remains a beloved family film worth watching.

title: Hunchback of Notre Dame
description: The Hunchback of Notre Dame (1996) follows Quasimodo, the kind-hearted yet isolated bell ringer of Notre Dame, who longs to explore the world and finds friendship in the fearless Esmeralda. Against the tyranny of Judge Frollo, he must choose between obedience and defending justice. With stunning animation, powerful Alan Menken music, and mature themes of prejudice, acceptance, and love, it’s one of Disney’s most dramatic and emotionally resonant films—highly worth watching.

title: Heavyweights
description: Heavyweights is a 1995 Disney comedy about kids at a weight-loss summer camp whose fun is derailed when an overzealous fitness guru takes over, turning it into a strict training ground. With help from sympathetic counselors, they plot to reclaim their summer. Though a box office flop, it’s now a cult favorite for its offbeat humor, 90s charm, and Ben Stiller’s over-the-top villain, offering lighthearted fun for fans of quirky family comedies.

title: Richie Rich
description: Richie Rich follows the world’s wealthiest boy, who has everything money can buy except true friends. When a plot targets his family’s fortune and safety, he must rely on his wits, loyal staff, and newfound pals to set things right. Lighthearted and filled with imaginative gadgets, it’s a kid-centric adventure that offers charm and fun over depth, making it enjoyable family fare for younger audiences.

title: The Goonies
description: The Goonies follows a tight-knit group of kids in a coastal town who embark on a high-stakes treasure hunt after finding an old pirate map—a quest that could save their homes from foreclosure. Their adventure leads through underground tunnels, elaborate booby traps, and run-ins with a criminal family. Loved for its charm, energy, and camaraderie, it’s a nostalgic, fun ride that blends youthful humor with Spielberg-style adventure.

title: The Princess Bride
description: The Princess Bride blends romance, adventure, comedy, and fantasy in a storybook tale framed as a grandfather reading to his reluctant grandson. Farmhand Westley embarks on a perilous quest to reunite with his beloved Buttercup, encountering duels, giants, clever banter, and whimsical perils. Celebrated for its charm, wit, and quotable lines, it’s a timeless classic appealing to all ages.

title: The Black Couldron
description: The Black Cauldron is a dark fantasy adventure from Disney that follows young pig-keeper Taran, who dreams of heroism but is thrust into a perilous quest to stop the fearsome Horned King from using a magical cauldron to raise an undead army. With its atmospheric animation, eerie villain, and absence of songs, it’s an atypical and darker Disney entry. While flawed in pacing and tone, it’s a visually striking cult favorite worth seeing for fantasy fans.

title: Pocahontas
description: Pocahontas (1995) tells the story of a free-spirited Native American woman whose encounter with Englishman John Smith challenges cultural divides and inspires her to follow her heart. With its lush, painterly animation, heartfelt songs like “Colors of the Wind,” and themes of harmony and understanding, it’s a visually striking and emotionally sincere Disney film. While historically inaccurate and lighter on villainy, it remains a worthwhile watch for its artistry and message.

title: The Aristocats
description: The Aristocats follows a refined family of Parisian cats whose pampered life is upended when a greedy butler tries to cut them out of an inheritance. Stranded in the countryside, they team up with a street-smart alley cat for a lively journey home. Filled with jazzy tunes, colorful animation, and charming characters, this lighthearted Disney classic is a fun, heartwarming watch, though its plot is simple and familiar.

title: Antz
description: Antz follows Z, a neurotic worker ant yearning for individuality, who unexpectedly gets swept into adventure after crossing paths with Princess Bala. As he navigates a rigid colony system and an ambitious general’s plans, Z’s quest blends humor, social satire, and action. Praised for its sharp wit, impressive early CGI, and an all-star voice cast, it’s more adult-oriented than typical animation, offering layered jokes and themes that make it worth watching for grown-ups as well as older kids.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: Beauty and the Beast (1991) tells of Belle, a spirited young woman who becomes entwined in the fate of a cursed prince transformed into a Beast, and discovers that true beauty lies within. Blending romance, wit, and memorable songs with groundbreaking animation, it was the first animated film nominated for Best Picture. Acclaimed for its artistry, music, and heartfelt storytelling, it remains a timeless Disney classic worth seeing.

title: A Kid in King Arthur's Court
description: A Kid in King Arthur's Court follows 14-year-old Calvin Fuller, a struggling Little Leaguer who is swept by an earthquake into medieval Camelot. Mistaken for a prophesied hero, he must help King Arthur defend his crown from the scheming Lord Belasco while overcoming his own fears. Mixing slapstick, time-travel fish-out-of-water comedy, and family-friendly adventure, it offers lighthearted fun for kids, though critics found it formulaic and dated.

title: Limo Ride
description: Ten friends hire a limousine to take them to a party, only to be kidnapped, stripped and left for dead on the side of the road.

title: Mad Ron's Prevues From Hell
description: A deranged projectionist shows a theatre full of zombies horror trailers from his collection.

title: Minding The Gap
description: Filmmaker Bing Liu returns to his hometown to document his friends’ daily lives. What he uncovers are revelations about where they’ve come from, apprehensions of who they’re becoming and a desire to course correct before it’s too late. MINDING THE GAP is a Peabody Award winning, Oscar and Emmy nominated documentary which made The New York Times critic A.O. Scott’s top 10 films of the decade list.

title: Gorotica
description: A jewel thief asks a necrophiliac to help him retrieve a diamond from his dead partner's stomach.

title: Running Scared
description: Mafia flunky Joey Gazelle (Paul Walker) is ordered to dispose of the guns that killed a pair of policemen. He hides them in his basement, where they are found by Oleg (Cameron Bright), the kid from next door, who uses one to shoot his brutal stepfather, a Russian mobster. The boy runs off, and Joey pursues him into the criminal underworld, desperate to retrieve the incriminating weapon. Meanwhile, corrupt detective Rydell (Chazz Palminteri) is following Joey's trail with his own agenda.

title: Malevolence 2: Berevement
description: Martin Bristol, a six-year-old, is abducted from his backyard swing and forced to witness the brutal crimes of a deranged madman.

title: Malevolence
description: Bank robbers (Brandon Johnson, Heather Magee) take two hostages to a rural farmhouse where a serial killer lurks.

title: The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo
description: Disgraced financial reporter Mikael Blomkvist (Daniel Craig) finds a chance to redeem his honor after being hired by wealthy Swedish industrialist Henrik Vanger (Christopher Plummer) to solve the 40-year-old murder of Vanger's niece, Harriet. Vanger believes that Harriet was killed by a member of his own family. Eventually joining Blomkvist on his dangerous quest for the truth is Lisbeth Salander (Rooney Mara), an unusual but ingenious investigator whose fragile trust is not easily won.

title: Lord Of War
description: An arms dealer confronts the morality of his work as he is being chased by an INTERPOL Agent.

title: The Girl Who Played With Fire
description: Computer hacker Lisbeth Salander is accused of three murders while investigating a sex-trafficking ring with journalist Mikael Blomkvist. Lisbeth goes on the run while Mikael works to clear her name.

title: The Broken Hearts Club
description: A fresh, funny, real story about a group of gay men in Hollywood, their lovers and friends, and the often hilarious, occasionally poignant space in between -- that is if they can get any space at all. As they make their ways in the world with and without each other, they are suddenly faced with an unexpected tragedy. The group finds comfort the only way they ever have -- together.

title: Hostel Part II
description: Beth (Lauren German), Lorna (Heather Matarazzo) and Whitney (Bijou Phillips), three young American women traveling abroad in Rome, decide to take a weekend excursion. Lured from their intended destination by a beautiful acquaintance (Vera Jordanova), the women anticipate a stay at a luxurious spa. Instead, they become pawns in a grisly game designed to entertain wealthy deviants from around the world.

title: Pet Semetary
description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient.

title: The Itaian Job
description: After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella, and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion.

title: Matrix Reloaded
description: Freedom fighters Neo (Keanu Reeves), Trinity (Carrie-Anne Moss) and Morpheus (Laurence Fishburne) continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation. In their quest to save the human race from extinction, they gain greater insight into the construct of The Matrix and Neo's pivotal role in the fate of mankind.

title: Sin City
description: In this quartet of neo-noir tales, a mysterious salesman (Josh Hartnett) narrates a tragic story of co-dependency, while a musclebound vigilante (Mickey Rourke) tears his way through the criminal underworld in search of his lost love (Jaime King). In another part of the city, a grizzled cop (Bruce Willis) foils the ambitions of a child-killer (Nick Stahl), and an ex-prostitute (Brittany Murphy) evades her ex-pimp (Benicio del Toro) with the help of her new boyfriend, Dwight (Clive Owen).

title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
description: Dave Stutler is just an average guy, but the wizard Balthazar Blake sees in him a hidden talent for sorcery. He becomes Balthazar's reluctant protégé, getting a crash course in the art of magic. As Dave prepares to help his mentor defend Manhattan from a powerful adversary, he wonders if he can survive the training, save the city and find his true love.

title: Office Space
description: Corporate drone Peter Gibbons hates his soul-killing job at software company Initech. While undergoing hypnotherapy, Peter is left in a blissful state when his therapist dies in the middle of their session. He refuses to work overtime, plays games at his desk and unintentionally charms two consultants into putting him on the management fast-track. When Peter's friends learn they're about to be downsized, they hatch a revenge plot against the company inspired by "Superman III."

title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
description: Strange things are afoot in the depths of the sea. First a passenger plane vanishes over the Pacific Ocean. Then an oil platform is obliterated. Marine biologist Emma MacNeil is dispatched to investigate the phenomena, and, with the help of Japanese scientist Seiji Shimada, she makes a discovery that will rock the world: An enormous prehistoric shark and a giant octopus have been awakened from their icy slumbers -- and they're hungry.

title: The Butterlfy Effect
description: College student Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) is afflicted with headaches so painful that he frequently blacks out. While unconscious, Evan is able to travel back in time to difficult moments in his childhood. He can also alter the past for friends, like Kayleigh (Amy Smart), who was molested by her father (Eric Stoltz). But changing the past can drastically alter the present, and Evan finds himself in nightmarish alternate realities, including one where he's locked away in prison.

title: Fever Pitch
description: When Ben Wrightman (Jimmy Fallon), a young teacher, begins dating pretty businesswoman Lindsey Meeks (Drew Barrymore), the two don't seem to have a lot of the same interests, but they fall in love, regardless. Their romance goes well until baseball season begins, and Lindsey soon realizes that Ben is completely obsessed with the Boston Red Sox. Though she tries to understand Ben's passionate team loyalty, eventually it threatens to end their otherwise happy relationship.

title: Session 9
description: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing ... abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors...

title: The Princess Diaries
description: Shy San Francisco teenager Mia Thermopolis (Anne Hathaway) is thrown for a loop when, from out of the blue, she learns the astonishing news that she's a real-life princess! As the heir apparent to the crown of the small European principality of Genovia, Mia begins a comical journey toward the throne when her strict and formidable grandmother, Queen Clarisse Renaldi (Julie Andrews), shows up to give her "princess lessons."

title: Kissing Jessica Stein
description: Jessica (Jennifer Westfeldt) is at the end of her emotional rope. She happens upon an intriguing personal ad, whose only drawback is that it's in the "women seeking women" section. On a daring whim, she decides to answer it. She meets funky downtown hipster Helen Cooper (Heather Juergensen) for drinks, and to her surprise, they click instantly. With conventional gender roles absent, the two women proceed to muddle through an earnest but hilarious courtship, making up the rules as they go.

title: Nick & Norah's Ultimate Playlist
description: Nick (Michael Cera) cannot stop obsessing over his ex-girlfriend, Tris (Alexis Dziena), until Tris' friend Norah (Kat Dennings) suddenly shows interest in him at a club. Thus beings an odd night filled with ups and downs as the two keep running into Tris and her new boyfriend while searching for Norah's drunken friend, Caroline (Ari Graynor), with help from Nick's band mates. As the night winds down, the two have to figure out what they want from each other.

title: Millions
description: When 9-year-old Damian finds a bag of money in his backyard, he and his brother Anthony decide to try to spend it without telling their father. Seeking advice from the imaginary saints with whom he converses, Damian struggles with his own morality, and attempts to spend his money in a more altruistic way. News of the mysterious loot inevitably attracts attention, however, and Damian is faced with an increasingly hairy situation.

title: Hard Candy
description: Hayley is a precocious teenager who goes to a coffee shop to meet Jeff, the photographer she met on the internet. Jeff thinks he is in for a real treat, but Hayley plays a trick on him. After drugging Jeff and tying him down, Hayley reveals that she knows Jeff preys on teenage girls, and she has a plan to wring a confession from him.

title: Quills
description: A fictional work that reconstructs the unknown fate of the Marquis de Sade, the writer and sexual deviant who was imprisoned in an insane asylum for the last 10 years of his life. The Marquis de Sade befriends the director of the asylum and shares affections with the asylum laundress. When a doctor is sent in to cure the Marquis of his supposed madness, the Marquis's rebellious character only grows stronger.

title: The Illusionist
description: In the 1900s Vienna, mesmeric entertainer Eisenheim's magical abilities are wowing the crowds, with an act that ranges from mere tricks to an apparent capacity to raise the dead. However, he has also long been in love with Duchess Sophie von Teschen, which puts him in dangerous competition with the violent, scheming Crown Prince Leopold, who jumps at the opportunity to have the magician arrested on grounds of necromancy.

title: Escape Clause
description: A man finds out that his wife has paid $10,000 to have him killed. Then both the would-be killer and the wife turn up dead ...
